selected_problem: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. Fresh-main inspection found a narrow context-recovery inconsistency: the centralized repository/context policy already rejects credential-like path segments at any depth, but `core/federated-generation.mjs` still carried an older end-of-path-only secret regex. A federated proposal could therefore admit `secrets/token.txt`, `credentials/service.json`, or `.env.local/nested.txt` into `needs_more_context` even though the authoritative downstream context bundle must reject those requests. This wastes autonomous recovery attempts and makes proposal admission disagree with the repository's current sovereignty policy.

truth_boundaries: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. This closes one contradictory context-request admission path; it does not create missing semantic code-generation capability.
